source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: instructions PDF page 7 codes 05E and 06E; PDF page 9 code 49E (residents taxed on all income); Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = New York State public pension (person 0) 48,000.00 = 48,000.00. Federal taxable income = 48,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 32,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 1 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. No Schedule E adjustments. IT-540 Line 7 federal AGI 48,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 1) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 48,000.00 - 12,500.00 = 35,500.00. Line 11 = 35,500.00 x .03 = 1,065.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 1,065.00. Code 05E reaches only systems exempted by Louisiana law, and every system on the FAQ list is a Louisiana system, so a New York State pension is not exempt. Code 06E needs age 65. No relief at 60.
